steps: Manage emergencies: hypercalcaemia (fluids + bisphosphonate), AKI (hydration, stop nephrotoxins), cord compression, infection.
Bone disease: bisphosphonate (zoledronic acid) + analgesia ± radiotherapy/vertebroplasty.
Refer haematology — definitive therapy is combination anti-myeloma regimens ± autologous stem-cell transplant.
Anaemia support; VTE prophylaxis with immunomodulatory regimens; vaccination/infection prophylaxis.
Confirm with serum/urine electrophoresis, free light chains, marrow and imaging.

confirm: CRAB features — hyperCalcaemia, Renal impairment, Anaemia, Bone lesions/pain — with paraprotein and clonal marrow plasma cells.
